adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, decrypted `keys` are `JSON.parse(...)`’d and written directly to `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key: keys } })` / `create({ data: { key: keys, ... } })` with no validation against the target app’s expected credential schema (only `userId`, `appSlug`, and encrypted `keys` string are validated). This can persist an invalid `credential.key` shape for a given `appSlug`, and multiple services in the diff later assume certain fields exist (e.g., Google uses `googleCredentials.refresh_token` during refresh; Office365 merges expected token fields; etc.), so a mismatched payload from the parent app can cause runtime errors or broken integrations on next use.
